children: GEORGE RISK INDUSTRIES, INC. reported first-quarter 2027 results with revenue rising to $6.85M while net income fell to $2.19M and diluted EPS declined to $0.45 versus the year-ago quarter, reflecting higher costs and lower unrealized investment gains.
Revenue was $6.85M for Q1 2027, compared with $5.90M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 16.1%.
Net income was $2.19M for Q1 2027, compared with $3.79M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change (42.2%).
Diluted EPS was $0.45 for Q1 2027, compared with $0.77 in the year-ago quarter.
Net sales rose 16.14% year-over-year, driven by resilient demand and niche product competitiveness.
Cost of goods sold increased to 52.9% of sales from 48.8%, reflecting higher labor and material costs and a focus on reducing backlog.
Income from operations improved 5.4% as management pursued leaner facilities and backlog reduction measures.
Inventories increased to support sales growth while accounts receivable collections improved (7.12% >90 days).
Ongoing product development includes wireless/contact sensors, explosion-proof UL listed switches and other new product lines.
